# v3.19-dev

## Fixed

- **Program and Offering dashboards no longer forget your view when you go Back.**
  Opening someone's record from a **View students** list and pressing Back
  returned you to the dashboard's default view — the program dashboard reset its
  **View** scope and **Compliance as of** horizon, and the offering dashboard
  reset to an empty country/region selector showing nothing at all. Checking a
  couple of people meant re-picking the scope each time.

  Both pages now keep your selection in the page address and restore it on the
  way back, the same way the report pages and Compliance Planning already do.
  Nothing to turn on.

  On the program dashboard, a link naming a level or value the program no longer
  has falls back to its default view rather than showing an empty one — so an
  old bookmark still lands somewhere useful.

## Also in this release

- Both dashboards are now **bookmarkable and shareable** as a consequence of the
  above: copy the page link and it reopens on the same scope (and, for a program,
  the same projection horizon).
